do_not_change.summary: Keep reviewSource limited to the controller Signal ID.
do_not_change.evidence: The revised wrapper serializes only signalId and keeps Run IDs and raw graph relationships server-only, consistent with ADR-045.
do_not_change.impact: Preserves the existing investigation boundary without expanding browser-visible graph coordinates.
do_not_change.recommendation: Do not add Run IDs, relationship rows or legacy-inference details to the app DTO.

do_not_change.summary: Retain POST as the established parameterized Growth-read transport while enforcing read-only behavior in the handler and service.
do_not_change.evidence: Sibling parameterized Growth reads consistently use POST, project context middleware, strict validators and read services; the plan prohibits provider calls and mutations.
do_not_change.impact: Avoids a one-off transport convention without conflating POST transport with mutation authorization.
do_not_change.recommendation: Preserve project-context reconstruction and test that the handler/service invoke only read dependencies.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve explicit read-only treatment of accepted Recommendations without an Action.
do_not_change.evidence: ADR-041 retains accepted rows until an Action exists, while ADR-045 defines review transitions only from proposed or snoozed.
do_not_change.impact: Prevents a legacy lifecycle state from exposing approval or review controls.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep the eligibility gate independent of controller-source presence.
